guide.title: Jas nab'ano ruk' LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Cha' Windows o Android, katana' ri taq q'at rech ri nuk'ulem, tikirisaj ri etab'al, k'a te ri' q'ata xuquje' sik'ij ri utzijoxik.
guide.mockBody: Mock Local Device jun kematz'ib' rech k'utunik k'o chupam. Ri turaq keb'ano taq etab'alil q'alaj chi mock, rech katetamaj ri b'eyal man k'atzin ta jun kematz'ib' ximonik.
guide.pcBody: Local PC nuk'ut ri e qas Windows process. Cha' jun process turaq rech nak'am CPU xuquje' memory. FPS k'atzinel jun q'alaj PresentMon capture.
guide.androidBody: Pa ri oyonib'al, tikirisaj Developer options xuquje' USB debugging, ya' q'ij che ri PC, jaq ri app katraj katijtob'ej, k'a te ri' cha' waral xuquje' tikirisaj jun session.
guide.deviceConcept: Kematz'ib': ri ruxe'el jawije' nik'am wi ri etamab'al, jas ri PC o jun Android oyonib'al.
guide.targetConcept: Turaq: ri app, etz'anem o process katraj ka'etaj pa ri kematz'ib'.
guide.sessionConcept: Session: jun mul retajik. Tikirisaj, tatz'eta ri etab'alil, q'ata, k'a te ri' tajaq ri utzijoxik.
support.title: Chomaj / Taq jun sachoj
support.body: Nab'e tajtob'ej jun jikomal tikirib'al chik xuquje' retamaxik ri taq samajib'al. We k'a k'o na ri k'ayewal, jaq ri GitHub bug form ri chomatalik.
support.repairDescription: Tikirisaj chik ri k'amab'al pa we k'olib'al xuquje' tajtob'ej chik ri kematz'ib' xuquje' samajib'al.
support.repairingHelp: Tajin nitikirisax chik ri k'amab'al xuquje' ketajtob'ex chik ri samajib'al xuquje' kematz'ib'.
support.repairSuccess: Xk'is ri chomaxik. Xk'ak'ar ri rub'anikil taq samajib'al xuquje' kematz'ib'.
support.repairFailed: Man xk'is ta ri chomaxik pa rib'il rib'. Katikïr nataq jun sachoj rech nik'oxïk chik.
support.submitDescription: Jaq ri GitHub bug form ri chomatalik ruk' jun pitz'.
support.submitFailed: Man xjaqataj ta ri GitHub bug page.
support.include: Taq utzilaj ub'anikil: ruwäch app, ruwäch Windows/Android, uwäch kematz'ib', jas xpitz', jas xoyob'ex, jas xk'ulmataj, taq wachib'al xuquje' diagnostics export ri ch'ajch'ojirisam.
support.privacy: Maya' ta token, account, ronojel ri b'ey pa we k'olib'al, raw logs, raw CSV, logcat, bugreport o taq ichinan wachib'al.
device.mockDescription: Etamab'al rech jikomal. Ri etab'alil b'anonik, q'alaj chi mock.
device.localPcDescription: Retamaxik ri e qas Windows process xuquje' ucha'ik CPU/memory.
session.beginnerBody: Pa ri nab'e etab'al, cha' Windows, cha' jun app process tajin nisamaj, pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al, q'ata chi rij jujun segundos, k'a te ri' jaq ri utzijoxik.
session.platformSubtitle: Tikirisaj ruk' ri nuk'ulem katraj katijtob'ej. LumaTrace nucholajij ri jun chik q'at, ri etab'alil man k'o ta kewa' N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Cha' jun app o etz'anem process pa we PC, k'a te ri' tikirisaj ri etab'al. We nitz'apix ri process, niq'at ri session o nitz'ib'ax jun q'alaj q'atoj.
session.platformAndroidBody: Pa ri oyonib'al tikirisaj Developer options xuquje' USB debugging, ya' q'ij che ri PC, jaq ri app katraj katijtob'ej, k'a te ri' pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al. LumaTrace nretamaj pa rib'il rib' ri package k'o chuwäch.
session.targetHelp: Ri jikom taq default e utz chik.
session.runningHelp: Kojtesaj ri app jas ri ub'anik. K'isaj ri etab'al are nak'amowaj chik ri qanil katraj ka'etaj.
session.defaultStep2: Tana' ri rutzijol ximonik o ucha'ik app rech ri nuk'ulem.
session.defaultStep3: Tikirisaj ri etab'al are cha'talik chik jun kematz'ib' xuquje' jun turaq.
session.choosePlatformFirstTitle: Cha' jun nuk'ulem rech nik'ut chik
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Chi rij ucha'ik Windows o Android, we k'olib'al ruk' xa ri kematz'ib', turaq xuquje' ri tikirib'al rech ri nuk'ulem.
session.windowsStep2: Cha' ri app process pa Target.
session.windowsStep3: Pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al. We k'o PresentMon, CPU, memory, FPS xuquje' frame time kek'ak'ar pa qas ramaj; we man k'o ta, FPS N/A.
session.androidStep1: Pa ri Android oyonib'al, tikirisaj Developer options, tzijob'ej USB debugging, xima ri USB xuquje' ya' q'ij che ri PC.
session.androidStep2: Jaq ri app katraj katijtob'ej pa ri oyonib'al.
session.androidStep3: Pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al. LumaTrace nretamaj pa rib'il rib' ri package rech ri app k'o chuwäch.
session.mockHint: Ri Mock turaq xa rech retamaxik ri b'eyal. Man e qas ta etab'alil rech kematz'ib' o app.
session.noPlatformDevice: Majani k'o ta jun kematz'ib' rech we nuk'ulem.
session.androidForegroundTitle: Ri app k'o wakami pa ri oyonib'al
session.androidForegroundPending: Jaq ri app pa ri oyonib'al, k'a te ri' pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al. Ri ub'i' package nik'ut waral are xetamaxik.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Ri e jaqatal app keb'e nab'e. Ri tzukunik xuquje' keril ri process e k'o chi rij.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Maj jun Windows process nuchap we tzukunik. Tajtob'ej jun chik b'i'aj o k'ak'arisaj ri taq turaq.
session.exportLogsToReportDir: Kol ri log pa ri uk'olib'al utzijoxik
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Android nukol jun ch'ajch'ojirisam ADB logcat pa ri ramaj etab'al. Windows nukol taq LumaTrace session record ruk' retab'al ramaj.
session.openReportAfterStop: Jaq ri utzijoxik rech we samaj
session.advancedSettings: Taq nim taq nuk'ulem (cha' chi awäch)
session.noWindowsTargets: Majani xil ta jun Windows app process tajin nisamaj. Jaq ri app o etz'anem katraj katijtob'ej, k'a te ri' k'ak'arisaj ri taq turaq.
session.noAndroidTargets: Majani k'o ta jun Android app turaq. Tikirisaj Developer options xuquje' USB debugging, ya' q'ij che ri PC, jaq ri app pa ri oyonib'al, k'a te ri' k'ak'arisaj.
device.title: Ub'anikil ri kematz'ib'
device.subtitle: Ri taq turaq xuquje' ri etab'alil k'o pa ri kematz'ib' cha'talik rech local-server.
device.androidHelp: Android Beta k'atzinel Developer options xuquje' ruq'ij USB debugging. Kuya' q'alaj Start App / Stop App lifecycle controls, process rebind diagnostics xuquje' ch'ajch'ojirisam cache/health. CPU, memory, battery xuquje' network k'atzinel adb. FPS tajin na netajtob'ex.
device.pcHelp: PC Beta nuk'ut ri Windows process pa we k'olib'al xuquje' kuya' nuqasaj CPU/memory ximon ruk' PID. FPS xuquje' frame time k'atzinel PresentMon xuquje' tajin ketajtob'ex; ri executable paths kemuj chuwäch kek'ut.

session.title: Session rech etab'al
session.subtitle: Cha' jun nuk'ulem, cha' ri turaq app o process, tikirisaj ri k'amab'al, k'a te ri' q'ata xuquje' sik'ij ri utzijoxik.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Ri network counters rech kematz'ib' rik'in jub'iq' k'o ri traffic rech nik'aj chik app.
session.uidNetworkNotice: Ri UID-level network stats ketayik pa dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Android network nrokisaj UID-level netstats we k'o, we man k'o ta nitzolin pa counters rech kematz'ib' ruk' q'alaj precision.
session.androidFpsNotice: Android FPS/frame time tajin netajtob'ex xuquje' netajtob'ex pa ri etab'al ruk' public ADB frame stats. We Android man nuk'ut ta jun frame data q'alaj, N/A.
session.pcNotice: Windows tests ketajtob'en pa kib'il kib' realtime PresentMon FPS/frame-time we k'o PresentMon. CPU xuquje' memory kakajusaj we maj PresentMon. PresentMon availability: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Ri ko'l taq ajilanik kek'am aninaq xuquje' ri curve qas ramaj, xa k'u wi kokisaj más CPU. Ri nim taq ajilanik man jeqel ta xuquje' e utz chike ri nimaq taq etab'al, xa k'u wi ri curve man k'o ta qas ub'anikil. 100 ms jun utz default.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Cha' jawije' kekol wi ri taq utzijoxik. Are nik'is ri etab'al, LumaTrace nutz'ib'aj HTML, JSON xuquje' CSV pa we k'olib'al.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Nokisax are ri local server nuq'alajisaj jun k'olib'al.

report.performanceGroupHelp: Tikirisaj waral: FPS nuk'ut ri lemowem, 1% Low xuquje' frame time nikik'ut ri jikomal.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: CPU, GPU xuquje' memory xkoj pa ri etab'al rech we app o process.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Power, GPU temperature, battery xuquje' network etamab'al xk'am rumal ri nuk'ulem.
report.performancePoor: Ri nik'aj FPS ja {avg}, man nuchapo ta 30 FPS. Man utz ta ri usamaj xuquje' k'o jun nimalaj q'atoj nitz'et.
report.performanceFair: Ri nik'aj FPS ja {avg}, pa nik'aj 30 xuquje' 59.9 FPS. Utz ri usamaj, xa k'u wi ri nimaq taq uwäch man kelemow ta.
report.performanceGood: Ri nik'aj FPS ja {avg}, 60 FPS o más. Utz ri usamaj xuquje' ri kojinem nlemow nab'e q'ij.
report.performanceUnavailable: Man xk'am ta ri nik'aj FPS, rumal ri' we utzijoxik man kuya' ta rajil ri rendering.

report.stabilityUnavailable: Maj k'iy 1% Low etamab'al rech netajtob'ex ri jikomal frame-rate.
report.performanceThresholdNote: We FPS taq q'atoj xa jun chunguj. Ri turaq frame-rate cap, display refresh rate, visual settings xuquje' test scenario nikijalo ri ub'anikil.

report.downsampledPreview: Ri nimaq taq utzijoxik nikokisaj bucket averages rech ri chart preview. Ri raw exports man kek'ex ta.
report.noTrendDataMessage: FPS, frame time, CPU xuquje' memory charts kewa' N/A we maj jun ajilab'al sample.
report.exportHelp: We etab'al xk'oji' pa {duration}. {metrics} raw metric samples k'o chi elesaxik.
report.noPresentMonMessage: FPS xuquje' frame time kewa' N/A we ri capture tz'apital, man k'o ta, man q'alaj ta o man junam ta.
report.presentMonNotice: PresentMon capture q'alaj xuquje' tajin netajtob'ex. Ri utzijoxik man k'o ta raw CSV o ronojel ri b'ey pa we k'olib'al.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Ri elesab'al ch'ajch'ojirisam, man k'o ta logcat o bugreport output.

packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Pa dev mode katikïr nakoj pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check1: Ri local-server paketalik nixim xa ruk' 127.0.0.1.

packaging.check8: Ri Windows packaging release readiness q'aton k'a kek'is ri production gates.
packaging.check9: Production signing, updater, notarization xuquje' store distribution man e nuk'um ta.
packaging.rcNotice: We nuk'ulem nuchap sidecar readiness, manual GUI QA, release policy xuquje' RC gate evidence pa jun ch'ajch'ojirisam uwäch. Man release approval ta, xuquje' productionReady k'a false.

session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Maj jun jaloj. Chakatisaj ruk' CPU xuquje' memory, o tikirisaj FPS chi rij.
